name: Azeroth Companion
title: iPHONE FULLSCREEN MAP STABILITY — EXIT & SELECTION FEEDBACK
approval_note: Owner reported fullscreen map trapping iPhone users, no accessible close, and no indication of selected destinations. Source fix includes iOS-safe fullscreen portal, in-map controls and matching discovery detail synchronization. Real iPhone acceptance pending.
features: Always-visible fullscreen exit button in top safe-area toolbar.
In-fullscreen destination details bottom sheet with View Destination Details and Copy Game Pin actions.
Return to prior layout with scroll unlock and focus restoration on exit.
Map pins and game-map imagery retain interactive styling when fullscreen is portaled outside the main site shell.
Synchronize pin selection with v23 discovery card and provide browser test coverage without resetting local saved data.
